hypothesis: Integer partition lattice P(N, K) with majorization order 가 chain (totally ordered) 일 조건의 closed-form characterization. 직전 1c5d717 의 open problem (general (N, K) chain condition) 해결.

main_results.theorem_3_chain_characterization: P(N, K) is a chain ⟺ K ≤ 2 ∨ N ≤ 5. 동등하게 NOT chain ⟺ K ≥ 3 ∧ N ≥ 6.

proof_structure_three_directions.direction_A_K_leq_2: K ≤ 2: partitions linearly ordered by max element. K=1 trivial single element. K=2 explicit partial sum verification.
proof_structure_three_directions.direction_B_N_leq_5: N ≤ 5: enumeration case analysis. N=0,1,2,3,4,5 explicit pairwise majorization comparison. 가장 의심스러운 N=5 pair (3,1,1) vs (2,2,1) — partial sums (3,4,5) vs (2,4,5), (3,1,1) majorizes (2,2,1) ✓.
proof_structure_three_directions.direction_C_K_geq_3_and_N_geq_6: K ≥ 3 ∧ N ≥ 6: explicit counter-example (4+(N-6), 1, 1, 0, ..., 0) vs (3+(N-6), 3, 0, 0, ..., 0). Simplest (N=6, K=3): (4,1,1) vs (3,3,0). Partial sums (4,5,6) vs (3,6,6). k=1: 4>3 v_a wins, k=2: 5<6 v_b wins → incomparable. General N>6 construction similar (extra mass absorbed into first part).

main_results.combined_result_with_1c5d717_theorem_2: Theorem 2 (T_λ ordering ⟺ majorization) + Theorem 3 (chain ⟺ K≤2 ∨ N≤5) = Cressie-Read T_λ exact p-value method-agnostic across all λ ∈ ℝ ⟺ K ≤ 2 ∨ N ≤ 5.
main_results.hand_snn_implication: 본 R&D 의 (N=5, K=4) 와 (N=3, K=4) 환경은 chain region (N ≤ 5) 의 정확한 boundary. 153/153 byte-identical empirical 은 우연이 아닌 Theorem 3 의 mathematical inevitable. Future N≥6 확장 시 method (λ) 선택 결정적이 됨 — single λ 결과 신뢰성 위험.

honest_limitations: Hardy-Littlewood-Polya 1934 Inequalities §2.18-§2.22 published edition 사용자 직접 verify mandatory (본 R&D 의 majorization framework 의 source-of-truth).
Direction (B) 의 N ≤ 5 enumeration 은 5 cases 만 explicit verify. Strict algebraic argument (enumeration 외) 는 future R&D.
Direction (C) 의 counter-example construction 은 (4,1,1,0,...) vs (3,3,0,0,...) family 한정. 다른 incomparable construction family 는 verify 안 함 (단 chain disproof 에 한 counter-example 충분).
Padding-invariance (v_a, v_b 의 zero-padding 에 의한 majorization 관계 보존) 는 standard 결과로 인용 — strict proof 는 본 R&D 에서 안 함 (Olkin & Marshall 1979 standard textbook 결과).
N=0, K=0 edge cases 는 trivially chain 으로 처리 — 본 proof 의 case analysis 는 N ≥ 1 가정.
NOT-chain regime (K ≥ 3 ∧ N ≥ 6) 의 detailed lattice structure (incomparable pair 수, antichain size, lattice height) 는 별도 R&D.
Formal verification (Lean 4 / Coq / Isabelle/HOL) 안 됨 — Mathlib partition lattice + majorization formalization 은 future R&D.

Cressie & Read 1984 §2.5, §3 published PDF + Read & Cressie 1988 §3 사용자 직접 verify mandatory (carryover).
Hand SNN R&D recommendation (§4.3) 은 derived advice — strict mathematical proof 가 아닌 method robustness 측면의 안내. Future R&D 의 method selection 은 별도 careful 결정 mandatory.
Peer review 안 됨 — statistical / combinatorics literature cross-check 사용자 mandatory.
